title.narrative: The Rehabilitation and development of the Great Zimbabwe World Heritage Site (WHS) project

description.narrative: The Great Zimbabwe Development project will help preserve the cultural heritage of and improve the conservation of the largest dry stone structure in sub-Saharan Africa. UNOPS will renovate and upgrade infrastructure at Great Zimbabwe with a new interpretive system and new visitor facilities. This will help strengthen the site's cultural heritage as well as increase national capacity for heritage enhancement and related economic development activities.
